# Callouts: Recovery 2.2-2.7 - the jumper column: RX, TX and RST stay on

Source: Own photo, raptox's LaunchPad, 2026-11-05  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec2-2_launchpad-uart-jumpers.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec2-2_launchpad-uart-jumpers.jpg)

The XDS110's serial port reaches the CC3220 through the RX and TX jumpers, its reset through RST. Leave every jumper here as shipped.
